offering_description.value: Provides broadband internet, television and phone service to households and businesses over its fiber and cable networks. It also provides dedicated fiber connections and managed network services to enterprises, public institutions and telecommunications carriers.

primary_services.value: broadband internet; television service; phone service; dedicated Ethernet and dark fiber; managed network services

customer_segment.value: B2C: Households buying home internet, television and phone service; B2B: Small businesses, enterprises and telecommunications carriers; B2G: Government agencies and public schools buying network connectivity

end_markets.value: home broadband and entertainment; business connectivity; telecommunications carriers; government; education

revenue_model.value: subscription: Monthly plans for internet, television, phone and business connectivity; rental or leasing: Long-term access to dark fiber strands for carriers and enterprises

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Builds and operates fiber and cable networks that connect homes, businesses and carrier networks; service provider: Uses its networks to deliver internet, television, voice and managed connectivity to retail and wholesale customers

geography_served.value: US regional: Mid-Atlantic and Ohio Valley, including Virginia, West Virginia, Maryland, Pennsylvania, Ohio and Indiana

specialization.value: related lines: Residential broadband, television and voice, enterprise connectivity and managed networks, wholesale fiber

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Phone sales for households and dedicated account teams for businesses, institutions and carriers; online: Company websites for address checks and residential plan orders

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Local cable franchise requirements and FCC and state oversight of telephone services
